description: From the sea the camera takes in the rocky peninsula of Gaeta: colorful houses fill the center slopes, the ruined Angevin castle crowns the crag above them, and sheer cliffs drop on the right with a dark sea cave at the waterline. Boats dot the deep blue water. The 12:05 midday sun is bright and clear.
